briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate frontier race with new reasoning benchmarks

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race intensifies as multiple labs release advanced reasoning models in August 2026. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows over autonomous agent deployments. Prompt injection and multi-agent security emerge as critical bottlenecks.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced chain-of-thought capabilities surpassing prior o-series. Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus and Google's Gemini 2.5 Pro trade leads on agentic tasks while Meta open-sources Llama 4.1 and xAI pushes Grok-3 updates.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. New NIST guidelines target agentic AI risks amid rising exploit reports.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1.2M units shipped. Microsoft and Google announce new 100k H100-equivalent clusters in Texas and Nevada. TSMC reports AI chip demand up 65% YoY.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will protocol-level dialect negotiation become mandatory for all multi-agent deployments by 2028?
